en.sub: No-script version. Works on any phone or browser, no JavaScript required.
en.notice: This page loads with no scripts, no tracking, and almost no data. For live status maps, speed rankings and translations, use the full interactive tracker when you have a stronger connection. Brought to you by Matokipedo.
en.rate_p: Tap a button next to a provider above. “By email” opens your phone's mail app pre-filled with the provider name — just add a score from 1 (unusable) to 5 (excellent), your city, and any comment, then hit send. “By SMS” opens your messaging app pre-filled the same way, addressed to {sms} — just fill in the score and city and send as a normal text. Either way: no app to install, no JavaScript, no data plan needed beyond sending one message.
en.rate_p_nosms: Tap a button next to a provider above. “By email” opens your phone's mail app pre-filled with the provider name — just add a score from 1 (unusable) to 5 (excellent), your city, and any comment, then hit send. No app to install, no JavaScript, no data plan needed beyond sending one message.

sn.sub: Chimiro chisina zvinyorwa. Chinoshanda pafoni ipi neipi kana bhurauza ripi neripi, hazvidi JavaScript.
sn.draftnote: ⚠️ Shanduro yekutanga — isati yaongororwa nemutauri womutauro uyu.
sn.notice: Peji rino harina zvinyorwa, hakuna kutevera, uye harishandisi data zhinji. Kune mepu dzemamiriro ari kuitika, kuongorora spidi, uye shanduro, shandisa tracker izere kana uine network yakasimba. Rinouya kwauri neMatokipedo.
sn.rate_p: Dzvanya bhatani pedyo nemupi. Email kana SMS zvinovhura zvakazadzwa kare — wedzera chiverengo chako (1–5), guta, uye tsananguro, wozotumira ku {sms}.

nd.sub: Inguqulo engelazikripthi. Isebenza kunoma yiliphi ifoni kumbe ibhrawuza, ayidingi i-JavaScript.
nd.draftnote: ⚠️ Uguqulo lokuqala — kalikahlolwa ngumkhulumi wolimi lwasekhaya.
nd.notice: Leli khasi kalilazikripthi, akulandelelwa, futhi kalisebenzisi idatha eminengi. Ukuze uthole amamephu esimo, ukuhlela isivinini, kanye nokuhumushwa, sebenzisa i-tracker egcweleyo nxa unenethiwekhi eqinileyo. Kulethwa nguMatokipedo.
nd.rate_p: Cindezela inkinobho eduze komphakeli. I-imeyili kumbe i-SMS ivula isicelo esesigcwalisiwe — engeza inani lakho (1–5), idolobho, lomcijo, bese uthumela ku {sms}.
nd._source: Extracted 2026-09-23 from zwispqosd lite-nd.html (v1.1.0 best-effort draft, unreviewed).

ny.sub: Mtundu wopanda zolemba. Umagwira ntchito pa foni iliyonse kapena bulawuza iliyonse, sufuna JavaScript.
ny.draftnote: ⚠️ Kumasulira koyamba — sikunasinthidwe ndi wolankhula chinenerochi.
ny.notice: Tsamba ili lilibe zolemba, silitsatiridwa, ndipo silimagwiritsa ntchito data yambiri. Kuti muwone mamepu a mkhalidwe, kuyeza liwiro, ndi matanthauzidwe, gwiritsani tracker yathunthu mukakhala ndi kulumikizana kolimba. Kuchokera kwa Matokipedo.
ny.rate_p: Dinani batani pafupi ndi opereka. Imelo kapena SMS zimatsegulidwa zitalembedwa kale — onjezerani chiwerengero chanu (1–5), mzinda, ndi ndemanga, kenako tumizani ku {sms}.

ts.sub: Nkarhi lowu nga riki na script. Wu tirha eka foni yihi na yihi kumbe bulawuza rihi na rihi, a wu lavi JavaScript.
ts.draftnote: ⚠️ Vuhundzuluxeri byo sungula — a byi si kambisisiwa hi muvulavuri wa ririmi leri.
ts.notice: Tluka leyi a yi na tiscripthi, a yi landzeleriwi, naswona a yi tirhisi data yo tala. Ku vona timephu ta xiyimo, ku kambela rivilo, na vuhundzuluxeri, tirhisa tracker leyi heleleke loko u ri na xihlanganisi lexi tiyeke. Yi tisiwa hi Matokipedo.
ts.rate_h2: Nyika xiviko eka muphani wa wena
ts.rate_p: Chava bugon lebyi nga kusuhi na muphani. Imeyili kumbe SMS wa pfula wu ri karhi wu tateriwile — engetela nomboro ya wena (1–5), doroba, na nhlamuselo, kutani u rhumela eka {sms}.
ts._source: Extracted 2026-09-23 from zwispqosd lite-ts.html (v1.1.0 best-effort draft, unreviewed).

st.sub: Mofuta o se nang script. O sebetsa mo founong efe kapa efe kapa sebatli, ha o hloke JavaScript.
st.draftnote: ⚠️ Phetolelo ya pele — e eso hlahlojwe ke sebui sa puo ena.
st.notice: Leqephe lena ha le na discript, ha le latelwe, mme ha le sebedise data e ngata. Ho bona dimmapa tsa boemo, tlhahlobo ya lebelo, le diphetolelo, sebedisa tracker e felletseng ha o e-na le khokahano e matla. E tliswa ke Matokipedo.
st.rate_h2: Fana ka tekanyetso ka mofani wa hao
st.rate_p: Tobetsa konopo pel'a mofani. Imeile kapa SMS e bula e tladitswe pele — eketsa palo ya hao (1–5), toropo, le tlhaloso, ebe o romela ho {sms}.
st._source: Extracted 2026-09-23 from zwispqosd lite-st.html (v1.1.0 best-effort draft, unreviewed).

tn.sub: Tokololo e se nang script. E dira mo founong efe kgotsa sebatlisisi sefe, ga e tlhoke JavaScript.
tn.draftnote: ⚠️ Thanolo ya ntlha — e ise e sekasekwe ke motho yo o buang puo eno ka tlholego.
tn.notice: Tsebe e ga e na diskripthi, ga e sale morago, mme ga e dirise data e ntsi. Go bona dimmapa tsa maemo, tlhatlhobo ya lebelo, le diphetolelo, dirisa tracker e feletseng fa o na le kgokagano e e nonofileng. E tlisitswe ke Matokipedo.
tn.rate_p: Tobetsa konopo fa go bapile le motlamedi. Imeile kgotsa SMS e bula e tladitswe pele — oketsa palo ya gago (1–5), toropo, le tlhaloso, mme o romele go {sms}.

ve.sub: Ndila i si na script. I shuma kha founu naho ifhio kana burausara naho ufhio, a i todi JavaScript.
ve.draftnote: ⚠️ Ṱhalutshedzelo ya u thoma — i sa athu sedzwa nga mubuli wa luambo ulu.
ve.notice: Siaṱari heyi a i na zwiscripthi, a i tevhelwi, nahone a i shumisi data nnzhi. U vhona mapa a vhuimo, u tolwa lubvelo, na phindulelo, shumisani tracker yo fhelelaho arali no vha na mvambo yo khwaṱhaho. I ṋetshedzwa nga Matokipedo.
ve.rate_p: Kanyisani bofho tsini na muṋei. Imeili kana SMS zwi vula zwo dzula zwo ḓala — engedzani tshiimo tshaṋu (1–5), doroba, na tsheleḓo, nga murahu ni rumele kha {sms}.

xh.sub: Uhlobo olungenazikripthi. Lusebenza kwiselula naliphi na okanye isikhangeli, alufuni i-JavaScript.

xh.notice: Eli phepha alinazikripthi, aliqwalaselwa, kwaye alisebenzisi idatha ninzi. Ukubona iimephu zemeko, ukuhlolwa kwesantya, kunye neenguqulelo, sebenzisa i-tracker epheleleyo xa unonxulumaniso oluqinileyo. Iziswa nguMatokipedo.
xh.rate_p: Cofa iqhosha ecaleni komboneleli. I-imeyile okanye i-SMS ivula izaliswe kwangaphambili — yongeza inqaku lakho (1–5), isixeko, kunye nengcaciso, uze uthumele ku {sms}.

pt.sub: Versão sem scripts. Funciona em qualquer telemóvel ou navegador, sem precisar de JavaScript.
pt.draftnote: ⚠️ Tradução preliminar — ainda não revista por um falante nativo.
pt.notice: Esta página carrega sem scripts, sem rastreamento e quase sem dados. Para mapas de estado em tempo real, rankings de velocidade e traduções, use o rastreador interativo completo quando tiver uma ligação mais forte. Uma iniciativa Matokipedo.
pt.rate_p: Toque num botão ao lado de uma operadora. O e-mail ou SMS abre já preenchido — acrescente a sua nota (1 a 5), a cidade e um comentário, e envie para {sms}.
